decisions.evidence: Taken together, the nitro group, the oximether group, the aromaticity, and the low QED support mutagenicity more strongly than the exposure-limiting lipophilicity, surface area, and aryl chloride pattern, so the molecule is predicted to be mutagenic, option (B).
Overall, the structure is more consistent with an Ames-positive compound, so it is predicted to be mutagenic.
